title: Boss AI: Fear Behemoth (multi-phase, armor plates, surges)
description:
Purpose: Boss-class behaviour with multi-phase logic, armor plates, corruption surges, sweeping beams, add spawns, vulnerability windows tied to construct interactions (ram/drill/turret pressure), and arena changes at health gates.

Phases:
- P1: Long-range beam sweeps with clear telegraphs; exposes minor weak spots briefly.
- P2: Armor plates open after stagger (ram impact) revealing drillable weak points; spawns adds.
- P3: Corruption surges (yellow) radiate periodically; Dome Shield mitigates; enrages with faster cycles.

Mechanics:
- Vulnerability Windows: After a successful ram or stagger combo, expose a weak plate for X seconds; applying Energy Jet/Drill reduces armor counter. Turrets add pressure during windows.
- Corruption Surge: Emits AoE that increases player ring drain unless inside Dome Shield; VFX and audio tells.
- Arena Shifts: On health gates, shifts cover geometry via scripted events.

Components:
- Reads: player state, construct impacts (ram collisions, drill contact), dome shield presence, mission tier.
- Writes: boss state machine, plate health, surge timers, spawn commands for adds.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_boss_phase_break_armor: Jet/Drill breaks plate during window.
- test_boss_dome_mitigates_surge: Dome reduces damage/drain inside vs. outside.

Integration:
- Hook via builtin.enemy_ai_hook with behaviour_id = "boss_ai_fear_behemoth" on fear_behemoth_boss entity.
- Coordinates with promoted.ring_construct_core events for construct hits.

Scenes:
- large_oa_defense_battlefield.

Suggested file split: boss_register.cpp, boss_state_machine.cpp, boss_attacks.cpp, boss_vulnerability.cpp, boss_arena_events.cpp.
